title: Preserve full chat history for local engines
goal: Carry the normalized OpenAI conversation and top-level tool schemas from the core 9091 server through GAWD and GEMI to the local engine, so a model adapter can render the model file's own chat template for multi-turn requests while preserving the existing prose fallback.

results.compile: affected-package cargo check passed after reconciliation
results.focused: server conversation/tool-schema parser test, GAWD swarm tests, plane-bus tests and Gemi VC-201-042 tests passed before final gate

limitations: The portable local-engine contract currently exposes four roles and string content; structured assistant tool_calls and tool_call_id fields remain normalized into text rather than a separate structured message field.
Cloud and external-provider recovery receives the assembled prose goal; the full chat is preserved for the local engine path only.
Linux x86_64 verification; Windows qualification remains a separate host task.
